resume_brief: In ~/workspace/trippedd-studio: the owner (2026-10-11) needs FREE one-turn AI image editing — Gemini's API needs billing on his keys, and he wants free backends COMBINED to beat Gemini, not just match it. TASK: (1) RESEARCH genuinely-free image-edit APIs: Pollinations.ai image-to-image (image.pollinations.ai prompt API with image param — zero signup, test if img2img works), Hugging Face Spaces with free Gradio endpoints (Qwen-Image-Edit / FLUX.1-Kontext spaces via gradio_client — user has verified HF account), AI Horde img2img (skill at ~/workspace/skills/ai-horde/SKILL.md — free but queued). Test each with a REAL edit: remove the arm from a cartoon torso (test image: production/TRIPPEDD_EP01/goodville/kits/amos-jr/torso_mirrored_punch.png on origin/main) and judge quality. (2) WIRE the winner(s) into tools/image-edit/edit.py as a new 'ai-edit' op: ONE CLI call = image + plain-language prompt -> edited image, with automatic fallback across backends (if one is down/queued, try the next). (3) THE DIFFERENTIATOR (why it beats Gemini): the op must be style-lock aware — after the edit, auto-run the sensorium style_hold check and a likeness check against the input (did the face change? it shouldn't), and report both. One turn, free, verified — that's better than Gemini. (4) Write a skill at ~/workspace/skills/free-ai-edit/SKILL.md documenting the backends. Keep the Gemini skill as-is (for later if he ever has an unmetered key) but the DEFAULT backend is free. Work on branch feat/free-ai-edit off origin/main, commit, open a PR (do NOT merge). Heartbeat ~/workspace/agent-ops/checkpoints/free-ai-edit.json every 10 min. Report: which backends tested, quality verdicts, the proving edit result, PR URL. Mark done at the end.
